change: F12 opens a bounded saved-region capture panel in Main inspection mode. Inclusive corners and anchor accept coordinates or the camera cell; a named self-contained .vstr saves to the existing structure library. Input is limited to 128 ASCII characters and names to 48 allowed characters. Frame owner admits one job and never reads source rows, encodes files or joins capture. A separate synchronous worker captures the validated viewed source SHA-256; mismatched valid files reject. Existing partial-World edit/capture/save gates remain closed.
lifecycle: Single worker owns capture and cleanup. Owner messages and worker progress/terminal updates share synchronization, preventing stale cancel messages from resurrecting RUNNING. Cancel ends at atomic package replacement; a late cancel keeps SAVED. Close is nonblocking, cancels active work and waits with event polling in the existing closing view. Failed cleanup retains its owner and directory until explicit retry/close; status queries do no I/O. HUD hides source paths, identities and raw exceptions. Existing output aliases of the source reject.
